system.description: As a Reaction, you can designate an enemy you have just hit with a melee attack. The enemy takes only half damage from the attack, but takes a -5 penalty on attacks made against you until the end of your next turn. A single target may only be affected by this Talent once per round. This is a Mind-Affecting effect.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
